question: Which of the following is the main objective of Golden Quadrilateral Super Highways?

options.text: To connect the district headquarters with other places of the district
To link a state capital with the different district headquarters
To link rural areas and villages to the cities
To reduce the time and distance between the mega cities

solution:
The **correct** answer is to reduce the **time **and distance between the **megacities**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **majority** of India's important **economic**, **agricultural**, and **cultural hubs** are **connected** by the national highway system known as the **Golden Quadrilateral**.
 
• In the **year 2000,** work on the "**Golden Quadrilateral** Highway Project"** began**.
 
• These super roads' **primary goal** is to **shorten** the** distance **and travel time between India's **four** major **cities**.
 
• It **connects** the four main **cities** in India—**Delhi**, Mumbai, **Kolkata**, and Chennai—forming a kind of quadrilateral.
 
• This **network** additionally provides **service** to Bengaluru, **Pune**, Ahmedabad, and **Surat**.
 
• The **National** Highways **Development** Project's (NHDP) **initial phase** was at issue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is **India**'s **largest** finished **highway** project.
 
• In the entire **world**, it is the **fifth-longest** **roadway** undertaking.
 
• The **Golden quadrilateral **has a total **length** of **5,846 kilometers**.
 
• **13 states** of India are included in the **Golden Quadrilateral**.
 
• The **Golden Quadrilateral**, often known as the "GQ," was the initial vision of former **Indian Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee. **
